computed.acceptance_criterion: Predict: (a) the synthesis reproduces E3's ceiling fidelity 0.99894 at (Omega/2pi=10 MHz, T=5 uK, theta=90 deg, r=4 um, Delta_nu=1 kHz) to rel 1e-6 (wiring single-fault check); (b) recoil scales as Omega^-2 and crosses the decay floor within the swept power range, so at Omega/2pi=40 MHz recoil < decay — the recoil-limited ceiling does NOT survive fast driving. Verdict reads computed.mitigation_verdict.recoil_below_decay_at_40MHz, computed.f_power.recoil_decay_crossover.power_mW, and computed.consistency.ceiling_fidelity_reproduced. CONFIRMED iff ceiling_fidelity_reproduced is true AND recoil_below_decay_at_40MHz is true AND recoil_decay_crossover.power_mW in [100, 2000]. REFUTED iff recoil_below_decay_at_40MHz is false OR ceiling_fidelity_reproduced is false.

f_theta.note: C6(theta) = C6(90deg)*sin^4(theta) drives blockade leakage epsilon = hbar^2 Omega^2/(2 V^2) with V = C6(theta)/r^6. Leakage diverges as theta->0 (gate fails on-axis; fidelity reported as 0). Below the crossover angle leakage dominates and the perturbative 'fidelity = 1 - total' goes negative (total infidelity > 1); the physical statement is gate failure (fidelity ~ 0). The crossover angle (leakage == recoil) is 53.77 deg, close to the Delta-M=0 magic angle 54.74 deg.

recoil_decay_crossover.note: at T=5 uK; where recoil (Omega^-2) equals decay (Omega^-1)

optimal.note: peak fidelity over the swept grid; the optimum exists because blockade leakage grows as Omega^2 while recoil/doppler decay as Omega^-2 and decay/phase as Omega^-1

f_power.note: At 40 MHz blockade leakage (Omega^2) overtakes every other term: fidelity 0.998756 is WORSE than the 10 MHz value 0.998942 and the ~19 MHz optimum 0.999376.

mitigation_verdict.conclusion: The recoil-limited ceiling does NOT survive at Omega/2pi = 40 MHz: recoil (2.41e-5) drops below decay (5.20e-5) at T=5 uK. BUT the mitigation is NOT beneficial — blockade leakage (proportional to Omega^2) grows to 1.107e-3 and becomes the new dominant channel, so fidelity at 40 MHz (0.998756) is below the 10 MHz value (0.998942) and well below the ~19 MHz optimum (0.999376). The fidelity-optimal operating point is ~19 MHz / ~443 mW. Driving at 40 MHz costs 1964.9 mW (~1.96 W) of 297 nm deep-UV, ~16x the 10 MHz power and ~4.4x the optimum — a prohibitive budget given the small single-photon Omega/sqrt(P) = 0.9024 MHz/sqrt(mW).

reproduce_pagano_revalidated.note: re-ran E3's decay+recoil machinery on Pagano2022 Sr-88 inputs (mass 1.46053e-25 kg, 323 nm, tau=50 us, T=0, blockade=0, linewidth=0); matches E3's stored values to machine precision, confirming the Omega-scaling machinery is identical.

consistency.note: E4's F(power) curve at (10 MHz, 5 uK) reproduces E3's computed.ceiling.fidelity 0.9989419909022649 exactly — the wiring of all consumed constants is verified (regression anchor, same error_terms machinery, not an independent method).

premise_corrections.premise: The E3 follow-up and report Sec.4 framing imply that suppressing recoil (driving faster) would lift the fidelity ceiling.
premise_corrections.corrected: For 297 nm single-photon at n=75 P3/2 (C6 = 3482 GHz*um^6), driving faster than ~19 MHz does NOT improve fidelity: blockade leakage (proportional to Omega^2) overtakes the suppressed recoil. F(40 MHz) = 0.998756 < F(10 MHz) = 0.998942 < F(19 MHz) = 0.999376.
premise_corrections.consequence: The recoil ceiling is real at the ~10 MHz operating point but is replaced by a blockade ceiling at 40 MHz; the fidelity-optimal Rabi is ~19 MHz (~443 mW), and the Sr/Yb-community 40 MHz point costs a prohibitive ~1.96 W of 297 nm.

anomalies.observable: fidelity at 40 MHz (0.998756) is WORSE than at 10 MHz (0.998942) despite recoil being suppressed 16x
anomalies.predicted: recoil drops as Omega^-2 (confirmed); a naive 'drive faster to kill recoil' would predict monotonic improvement
anomalies.observed: blockade leakage (Omega^2) grows to 1.107e-3 and dominates, producing a fidelity optimum at ~19 MHz
anomalies.reason: blockade leakage epsilon = hbar^2 Omega^2/(2 V^2) scales as Omega^2; with the small single-photon C6(75)=3482 GHz*um^6 at r=4 um, this overtakes the Omega^-2 recoil/doppler terms beyond ~19 MHz. Verified analytically (d(total)/dOmega = 0 quartic) and numerically.
